name: Stasharr
description: Intercepts Xtream Codes (XC) VOD playback requests and redirects players to Streamcache using canonical Dispatcharr playback URLs.
author: bruor

fields.label: Enable Stasharr Interceptor
fields.help_text: Master switch to enable or disable XC VOD redirection to Streamcache.
fields.description: Master switch to enable or disable XC VOD redirection to Streamcache.

fields.label: Streamcache Base URL
fields.help_text: The publicly accessible Streamcache endpoint that XC clients will be redirected to (e.g., https://streamcache.yourdomain.ca).
fields.description: The publicly accessible Streamcache endpoint that XC clients will be redirected to (e.g., https://streamcache.yourdomain.ca).

fields.label: Dispatcharr Base URL
fields.help_text: The canonical Dispatcharr base URL passed inside the target ?url= parameter that Streamcache uses to fetch media via /proxy/vod/... on cache misses. Setting this explicitly to match dp2strm ensures all requests use identical pathing and produce identical MD5 cache keys regardless of how a client connected.

actions.label: Check Hook Status

actions.label: Ping Streamcache
actions.description: Test HTTP connectivity from Dispatcharr to the configured Streamcache URL.
